lines.say: blocks PDE5; it's in the same drug class as tadalafil
better erections for 63% to 82% of men versus 24% on placebo
testosterone checked if it may be low; treating it may improve results (low certainty)
headache (16% versus 4% on placebo) and flushing (10% versus 1%)
color tinge or blurring; rare sudden vision loss from optic nerve damage (NAION)
severe blood pressure drop with nitrates or riociguat, added drop with alpha-blockers
erection over 4 hours (priapism), which can do permanent damage without prompt care

ask: Do any of my medicines, including nitrates, alpha-blockers or HIV drugs, interact with sildenafil?
